title: Open the hidden Library folder on macOS
summary: The Library folder in your home folder stores app settings and data, and Finder hides it by default. Open it in a Finder window whenever you need to look inside.

aliases.text: where is the library folder on mac
mac user library folder app data

steps.explain: Run open with the path ~/Library to show your user Library folder in a Finder window. The ~ stands for your home folder.

alternatives.explain: Same folder written with the full $HOME path, useful if ~ does not work in your shell.
alternatives.expect: A Finder window opens showing folders such as Application Support, Caches and Preferences.

steps.expect: A Finder window opens showing folders such as Application Support, Caches and Preferences.

verify.expect: A list of folder names such as Application Support, Caches and Preferences.
